set.body:
This item parks everything outside the MVP. Every item tagged later is blocked by it, so mote ready lists only MVP work. It closes after the MVP umbrella item.

To bring one parked item forward
The owner agrees that it replaces something in the MVP or that a Friday rehearsal showed it is needed. Then remove that item's dependency on this gate, tag it mvp with a journey tag, and rewrite its body in the MVP form (outcome, acceptance, not in scope, start from, evidence). Do not close this gate to unblock a single item.

When the pitch is done
Re-triage the later items against the approved pilot scope before closing this gate. Most were written in October for an institutional qualification programme (EP0 to EP9), or on 14 October for signal-level multimodal support, or on 18 November for exchange between installations. Many overlap work delivered since. Close what is already delivered, rewrite what remains, drop what the pilot does not need, and only then release the rest.

What is parked, by theme
- Exchange between installations: EP12, INT01 to INT04.
- Recovery, capacity and operations qualification: EP3, EP4, EP6, EP9, EP14, the O, H, Q and OPS series.
- Institutional identity qualification and guest lifecycle: EP2, F04.
- Curation work queues and project management: EP5, W01, W02.
- Signal-level EEG, MEG, physiology and eye-tracking: the multimodal series P, F, B, E, G, T, X, Q.
- In-process XNAT and DICOM adapter qualification: EP7, C01.
- Processing and report integration: EP8, W03.
- Neurobagel publication control and federation search: NB02, NB04.
- REDCap adapter: D08.
- Profile boundary refactors: EP13, PRO01 to PRO03.
- Known defects that no journey hits: ARC03 (paging after a rename), ARC05 (duplicate grant after a lost response).
set.title: GATE: MVP shown to the Vice-President, Research and a pilot approved
